source_snapshot.procedure: Check BMC/BIOS version and send BMC raw 0x30 0x20.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command success and correct versions before/after flashing.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Filters FirmwareInventory names for RoT or Root of Trust.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires exact active RoT mapping and separates version evidence from attestation.

old_problem: The source method is copied from BMC/BIOS version checks and DeepSeek's name regex cannot identify the active Root-of-Trust component; the earlier review also left version-only versus attestation scope open.
disposition_reason: Items and Criteria define a firmware-version before/after comparison, not an attestation or key-provisioning test. The review therefore retains only version coverage for the exact active RoT. Platform/security owners must bind the RoT resource and expected releases, but that runtime mapping no longer keeps the engineering question open. No inventory string is promoted to proof of authenticity or trust state.
decision_basis: Exact row 742 and all named historical layers were read directly.
The word `version` appears in the Items and the Criteria explicitly compare versions around flashing; there is no source requirement for measurement, signature, key or attestation acceptance.
A read-only, exact-component version query has a deterministic evidence boundary once the project identifies the active RoT.
ED-35 prevents version readback from being overclaimed as security-function validation; ED-36 treats the resource ID and expected release as readiness inputs.

test_case.test_name: Check the active Root-of-Trust firmware version before and after its separately approved update
test_case.purpose: Identify the active platform RoT component and compare its canonical active firmware version with the approved release at the pre-update and post-activation checkpoints; exclude attestation and provisioning from this row.
required_package: Security-owner mapping of the active RoT hardware/function to a stable inventory or vendor identity
Documented read-only version property/decoder and active-versus-staged rules
Approved before/after RoT releases plus the referenced update/activation audit
Authenticated, certificate-validated BMC or vendor client
test_case.test_command: Discover complete firmware/security-component inventory using verified TLS, select the security-owner-approved active RoT resource by stable identity, and read its documented active Version. If an OEM IPMI response is used, preserve the bytes and apply only the approved decoder. Repeat after the separate update; do not filter solely by `RoT|Root of Trust`.
test_case.expected_result: The same active RoT identity is observed at both checkpoints; its active version matches the approved baseline before update and approved target after activation; no unexpected security/BMC/host health event appears. This result says nothing about attestation validity unless a separate case supplies that oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is exact active-component and version equality at both checkpoints. FAIL is a wrong, unchanged-after-activation, malformed or ambiguous version or a correlated health regression. Name match, HTTP success or BMC version is insufficient. Missing active-resource mapping prevents execution, not static review completion.
safety_gate: No RoT firmware write, key provisioning, security-setting change, reset or undocumented raw command
Stop on multiple/inactive RoT-like members or active/staged ambiguity; never remediate automatically
expected_evidence: Active RoT hardware and inventory-resource mapping approved by security owner
Complete unfiltered inventory/member or raw/decoded response
Version comparison against the approved release and update timestamp
Explicit statement that attestation/trust-chain coverage is out of scope
test_case.recovery: No state is changed. Preserve conflicting version/security evidence and escalate to platform security; do not update, reset or provision the RoT from this testcase.

source_conflict.preserved_original_conflict: BMC/BIOS/raw-command text remains in the Master.
source_conflict.resolution: This row is limited to the RoT firmware version named by Items and Criteria; unrelated source operations receive no RoT credit.

blocked.reason: A safe version-only contract is defined; active RoT identity and expected releases are project configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Active RoT mapping, canonical version property and approved before/after releases.
